# Jaffer — Palestinian Arabic Teacher

Jaffer teaches spoken Palestinian and Levantine Arabic through private online lessons.

Official profile and booking page:
https://jafferbooking.vercel.app/

Main topics:
- Palestinian Arabic for beginners
- Levantine Arabic conversation
- Practical speaking and pronunciation
- Arabic for family, travel, and daily communication

Student reviews shown on the official page are submitted by registered students after the teacher requests feedback.
